strengths: Correctly identifies oligodendrocyte lineage from canonical myelin genes (Plp1, Mog, Mag, Mobp, Cnp, Mal, Cldn11)
Recognizes homogeneous oligodendrocyte population without other neural lineage contamination
weaknesses: Top2 subtype string (MOLs/NFOLs/DOLs) is unmapped and includes unsupported NFOL/DOL components
Top-ranked marker Ppp1r16b is not discussed

strengths: Top1 oligodendrocyte is fully supported by myelination markers
Rank2 mature myelinating oligodendrocyte (CL:4072003) provides the supported hierarchical refinement adopted in the final decision
weaknesses: Rank2 candidate score is NA; subtype confidence not quantified

strengths: Correct assignment based on canonical myelin markers and myelin-related pathway terms
Reasonable integration of GO/Pathway evidence for oligodendrocyte identity
weaknesses: No subtype granularity; does not differentiate mature myelinating oligodendrocyte from general oligodendrocyte
Heavy reliance on generic pathway enrichments

supporting: Cluster markers include canonical myelin genes Plp1, Mog, Mag, Mobp, Cnp, Mal, Cldn11, Omg, reinforcing oligodendrocyte identity.

Enrichment terms 'myelination', 'central nervous system myelination', 'axon ensheathment in central nervous system' and 'myelin sheath' directly support the myelinating component of mature myelinating oligodendrocyte (CL:4072003).
PMID 41618467 supports oligodendrocyte/myelination biology as allowed citation.
conflicting: No conflicting lineage markers (absence of neuronal, astrocytic, microglial, or endothelial markers).
Low-score candidate alternatives (endothelial, OPC, astrocyte) lack supporting DEG evidence.
